messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend periods in Canada for 2023 (based on the federal holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday).  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know – some holidays differ by region.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba) | Monday, Feb 20 | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Christmas** | Monday, Dec 25 | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Mon) |

> **Note:**  
> • New Year’s Day (Jan 1) falls on a Sunday, so it doesn’t create a long weekend.  
> • Canada Day (Jul 1) falls on a Saturday, so it also doesn’t create a long weekend.  
> • Remembrance Day (Nov 11) falls on a Wednesday, so it isn’t part of a long weekend.  

Feel free to plug these dates directly into your app’s calendar logic! If you need the list broken down by province or additional holidays, just let me know.
